prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: mobile-first web app direction comp, portrait 390×844, edge to edge, no browser or device frame.
Primary request: a practical parking-map app screen for「台灣停車預測」used by a driver near「新莊體育館」. It must remain a familiar working mobile app, not an album sleeve or printed object.
Composition: a compact search/navigation row at top, a central street map with destination D and individually tappable roadside markers, a distinct off-street garage marker, then a standard bottom drawer. Use a refined cassette J-card rhythm only as the signature: one clean horizontal divider through the selected-space detail, with concise fields aligned across its two sides; no literal cassette, no fold-out page. Show one selected roadside space and two comparison rows.
Exact Traditional Chinese labels:「新莊體育館」「附近車位」「正中路 25 號」「目前觀測：有位」「距離 180 公尺」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」「示意資料」. Display different available, occupied and unknown markers using text and shape as well as color.
Visual law: warm thick-card cream #f2dfbd, dark ink #352d2b, coral #d85b43, deep teal #3e746b. Compact readable type, tactile but flat dividers, clear aligned fields and spacing.
The map and search remain dominant; keep all controls conventional and touch friendly. No cassette image, lyric, album title, paper texture, poster composition, fake route ETA, invented prediction, copied ParkBoss graphics, tiny text or device mockup. Crisp high-fidelity app screen.
